  • The All-New Maxis Home Fibre plans provide high speed home internet with speeds up to 2Gbps. It also has the latest range of home devices that is easy to own with Zerolution.

    Click here for more information on the All-New Maxis Home Fibre plans.

  • There’s no one-size-fits-all answer. The right broadband plan depends on how you use the internet, how many people and devices share the connection, and the size of your home.

    • Light users — For casual browsing, online shopping and occasional streaming, 100Mbps (RM89/mth for the first 24 months) is suited to 2–3 devices, while 300Mbps (RM129/mth for the first 24 months) is a better fit for 4–5 devices and 4K streaming.
    • Online gaming — For gamers, a reliable connection matters, especially when multiple devices are connected at once. 500Mbps (RM149/mth for the first 24 months) is a solid starting point for households with 6–8 devices. If several people are gaming, streaming or working at the same time, step up to 1Gbps (RM249/mth). For 10+ connected devices and more demanding setups, 2Gbps (RM319/mth) is built for serious gamers and high-demand households. All plans come with unlimited data, so there’s no data quota to worry about when downloading games. For the best connection, use Ethernet where possible, or add Maxis MaxWiFi if your gaming setup is upstairs.
    • Heavy household users — Have lots of connected devices, stream in 4K or run smart home gadgets? 500Mbps, 1Gbps or 2Gbps can give your household more capacity to keep multiple activities running smoothly.


    Check fibre availability in your area and choose the speed that fits your household.

  • The best home internet plan in Malaysia depends on your household size, number of devices, and how you use the internet. For reliable, high-speed, and unlimited broadband, Maxis Home Fibre is one of the top choices, offering fast fibre coverage and flexible speed options nationwide.     Maxis Home Fibre 300 Mbps RM129*/mth for the first 24 months Unlimited internet plan WiFi 6 certified router 4K streaming for the whole household on 4–5 devices
    Maxis Home Fibre 500 Mbps RM149*/mth for the first 24 months Unlimited internet plan WiFi 6 certified router Work, study and gaming on 6–8 devices
    Maxis Home Fibre 1 Gbps RM249/mth Unlimited internet plan Premium WiFi 7 certified router Smooth performance through peak hours on 8–10 devices
    Maxis Home Fibre 2 Gbps RM319/mth Unlimited internet plan Premium WiFi 7 certified router Ultra-fast, low-latency WiFi for serious gamers and high-demand households with 10+ devices

    If your new address is within coverage, just walk-in to any Maxis Store to request for relocation. On the installation day, please bring along your modem to new installation address; RM200 may be applicable for new modem.

2. Which broadband plan is the best in Malaysia?
There’s no one-size-fits-all answer. The right broadband plan depends on how you use the internet, how many people and devices share the connection, and the size of your home.
Light users — For casual browsing, online shopping and occasional streaming, 100Mbps (RM89/mth for the first 24 months) is suited to 2–3 devices, while 300Mbps (RM129/mth for the first 24 months) is a better fit for 4–5 devices and 4K streaming.
Online gaming — For gamers, a reliable connection matters, especially when multiple devices are connected at once. 500Mbps (RM149/mth for the first 24 months) is a solid starting point for households with 6–8 devices. If several people are gaming, streaming or working at the same time, step up to 1Gbps (RM249/mth). For 10+ connected devices and more demanding setups, 2Gbps (RM319/mth) is built for serious gamers and high-demand households. All plans come with unlimited data, so there’s no data quota to worry about when downloading games. For the best connection, use Ethernet where possible, or add Maxis MaxWiFi if your gaming setup is upstairs.
Heavy household users — Have lots of connected devices, stream in 4K or run smart home gadgets? 500Mbps, 1Gbps or 2Gbps can give your household more capacity to keep multiple activities running smoothly.
Check fibre availability in your area
and choose the speed that fits your household.

The best home internet plan in Malaysia depends on your household size, number of devices, and how you use the internet. 4. Is there any contract to sign up for the All-New Maxis Home Fibre plans?
Yes, there’ll be a 24-month contract for new sign ups.
5. Do the All-New Maxis Home Fibre plans come with a voice service?
For new customer, you have an option to add Unlimited Voice at RM10 per month which also comes with a free DECT phone. Alternatively, you may plug in your own telephone and will be charged on a pay-as-you-use basis at standard rates of RM0.09/minute charge to mobile and fixed line number. Standard rates for international and special numbers will apply.
For existing customer changing to the All-New Maxis Home Fibre plans, DECT phone is not provided and you will have to buy your own.
6. I am moving to a new house. How can I transfer my Maxis Home Fibre to my new place?
First, you need to perform fibre coverage check
here
.
If your new address is within coverage, just walk-in to any Maxis Store to request for relocation. On the installation day, please bring along your modem to new installation address; RM200 may be applicable for new modem.
If your new address is not within our coverage area, bring along your modem and walk into your nearest Maxis Centre to terminate your fibre service. Early termination fee is applicable if your existing service and home devices are still within contract.
